description:
The lunch menus (Mittagsmenüs) served today - or another day of this week - with
every dish and its price, near a point or in a map area; with `q`, only the lunch dishes
matching it ("schnitzel", "suppe").

ApiDiet.description: A diet as a menu marks a dish, or the dish's name says it.

ApiLang.description:
The language dish names, descriptions and section titles come in: the menus' own
German, or English as bissl translated them.

oneOf.description: The most useful lunches first: with prices, at places open for lunch.
Nearest to `lat`, `lon` first - the order whenever they are given, unless another.

bbox.description:
Keep to a map area: "west,south,east,north" in degrees - a town, a district, the
streets around a place. Everywhere when left out.

cuisine.description: Only at places of this cuisine, as OpenStreetMap names it: "italian", "vietnamese".

day.description:
"2026-10-20": another day of this lunch week, Monday to Sunday (at the weekend, the
coming week's too). Today when left out; open_now only counts today.

diet.description: Only dishes of this diet: vegan, or vegetarian (vegan dishes included).

free_of.description:
Only dishes whose menu lists their allergens and none of these letters: "A" gluten,
"G" milk, "AG" both.

lang.description:
The language of dish names, descriptions and section titles: de, the menus' own, or
en, as bissl translated them.

lat.description:
The latitude of a point - the user's, or one they name - to measure distances from
and sort nearest first; with `lon`.

limit.description: Places to answer with: 1 to 30, 10 when left out.

lon.description: The longitude of that point; with `lat`.

max_price.description: Only dishes costing at most this much, in whole euros.

min_price.description: Only dishes costing at least this much, in whole euros.

offset.description: Places to skip, for the next ones: 0 when left out.

q.description:
Words a dish must match, as people say them, German or English: "schnitzel", "vegan
curry", "glutenfreie pizza". A diet, allergens or a cuisine among them are taken as
filters; misspelt German words are put right when that finds something.

name: search_lunch_menus

ApiDiet.description: A diet as a menu marks a dish, or the dish's name says it.

Dish.description: A dish or drink on a menu, the same in every answer.

allergens.description:
The allergen letters its menu lists, by the Austrian codes (A gluten, B
crustaceans, C egg, D fish, E peanuts, F soy, G milk, H nuts, L celery, M mustard,
N sesame, O sulphites, P lupin, R molluscs); null when the menu lists none for it,
which is no promise it has none.

checked_on.description: The day its menu was last read from the venue's website.

diet.description: Vegan or vegetarian as the menu marks it or its name says; null when neither.

id.description: bissl's id of the dish on its menu.

prices.description: One per size or variant; none when the menu gives no price.

served_on.description: The day a lunch dish is served on; null for what the place always serves.

url.description: The venue's bissl page with this dish marked.

Place.description: A place to eat or drink, the same in every answer.

address.description: Street, house number, postcode and town; null when bissl has none.

area.description:
Its district or town, to say where it is: "7. Neubau", "Mödling"; null outside every
town bissl knows. No filter takes it.

cuisines.description: Its cuisines as OpenStreetMap names them: austrian, italian, pizza, vietnamese...

distance_m.description: Metres from the point asked about (`lat`, `lon`), when one was given.

kind.description:
Its kind as OpenStreetMap tags it: restaurant, fast_food, cafe, bar, pub,
biergarten, ice_cream, food_court, bakery or pastry.

open_now.description: Open right now by its opening hours (Vienna's time); null when bissl can't read them.

price_level.description: "€" to "€€€€" from its menu's prices; null while bissl doesn't know.

slug.description: bissl's name for the place: what `/v1/venues/{slug}` and `get_venue` take.

url.description: Its page on bissl, with every menu: link to it.

PlaceDishes.description: A place and its dishes in an answer: the dishes a search found there, or its lunch.

more_dishes.description: More of them there, on its page.

served.description: When its lunch is served, as its menu says: "11:00–14:30". Lunch only; null otherwise.

Price.description: A price of a dish: one per size or variant.

note.description: What it is for, when the menu says: a size or a variant ("0,5 l", "klein").

price.description: As the venue page writes it: "12,90 €".

price_cents.description: In euro cents; null when the menu names a size without a price.

corrected.description: The words put right when they found nothing as typed: "schnitzel" for "schnitzl".

day.description: The day the lunch menus are for.

diet.description: The filters in effect, asked for or taken from the words.

note.description: Why there is nothing, when there is a reason to say.

places.description: Each with its whole lunch that day - the dishes matching `q`, when it was given.

searched.description:
The words the dishes match, once a diet, allergens or a cuisine among them were taken
as filters; null for none.

total_places.description: Places serving lunch and their dishes, of which `places` holds `limit` from `offset` on.

title: Search lunch menus
